title: Park Youth
metaDescription: Find out about Park Youth at St John's Park, including Sunday Faith Explorers, Wednesday Cornerstone, and ways for secondary schoolers to belong.

sections.title: Park Youth
sections.body: Park Youth is a place for secondary schoolers to belong, explore faith, ask good questions, build friendships, and grow as followers of Jesus.

image.alt: Young people gathered for Park Youth

sections.title: Sundays and midweek
sections.intro: Park Youth has space on Sundays and during the week, with different rhythms for different kinds of connection.

cards.title: Faith Explorers
cards.body: Faith Explorers runs during the second part of the Sunday service for secondary schoolers up to 16.

cards.title: Cornerstone
cards.body: Cornerstone is our midweek Park Youth group for secondary schoolers, with friendship, faith, and space to talk honestly.

sections.title: Meet Revd Wachira
sections.intro: Wachira heads up Park Youth and helps young people find friendship, ask honest questions, and grow in faith.

cards.title: Revd Wachira Maina
cards.body: Wachira serves as curate at St John's Park and leads Park Youth alongside the wider team.

sections.title: Questions are welcome
sections.body: Teenagers are not expected to have faith all neatly worked out. Park Youth is a place to bring real questions, read the Bible together, pray, laugh, and discover what following Jesus can look like in everyday life.
points: A safe place to ask questions and explore faith.
Friendships with other young people in the church family.
Leaders who care about young people being known, listened to, and encouraged.

image.alt: Young people spending time together at Park Youth

sections.title: Want to know where to start?
sections.body: If you are a parent, carer, or young person with questions about Park Youth, we would be very happy to help you find the right first step.
